changes.comment: Rename the pre-publish public surface per docs/CONTROLS-API-NAMING-REVIEW.md: useControls -> useReactive, RenderControl -> Reactive, Finput/Fselect/Fcheckbox -> ControlInput/ControlSelect/ControlCheckbox, computed -> computeInto, as -> asControl, noopReadContext -> untrackedRead, getValueRx -> getTrackedValue, isFinalized -> isTracking (polarity flipped), setInitialValue -> reset with setInitialValueOnly taking its place, ControlSetup -> ControlOptions (elems -> elements, dontClearError -> keepErrors), ControlChange.All -> AllState, and ~20 more. useFormControlProps now returns { props, errorText }. See docs/MIGRATION-COMPAT-TO-CONTROLS.md.
